# Shift Handoff and Progress Note: Medical-Surgical Unit
Patient: Eleanor Vance | MRN: 482-9011 | DOB: 04/14/1967 | Room: 412-B

## Patient Profile and Baseline
| Parameter | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Admitting Diagnosis | Acute uncomplicated diverticulitis |
| Admission Date | 10/12/2026 |
| Attending Physician | Dr. Marcus Brody, MD |
| Allergies | Ciprofloxacin (severe hives/anaphylactoid reaction) |
| Code Status | Full Code |

## Vital Signs (0700-1500)
| Time | BP (mmHg) | HR (bpm) | RR (/min) | SpO2 (%) | Temp (°F) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0800 | 128/76 | 78 | 16 | 98 on RA | 99.1 |

| 1430 | 122/74 | 74 | 16 | 98 on RA | 98.8 |

## Assessment and Interventions
- Neurological: Alert and oriented x4. Bilateral hand grips equal and strong.
- Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm, S1/S2 present. Peripheral pulses 2+ throughout. Capillary refill under 2 seconds.
- Respiratory: Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally in all fields. No work of breathing.
- Gastrointestinal: Abdomen soft, moderately tender to palpation in left lower quadrant. Hypoactive bowel sounds in all four quadrants. Tolerating clear liquid diet without nausea or vomiting.
- Genitourinary: Voiding spontaneously via commode without dysuria. Strict I&O maintained: shift total 950 mL out, 1,100 mL in.

## Medication Administration and Care Plan
- Administered IV ciprofloxacin 400 mg at 1000 per pharmacy schedule.
- Peripheral IV 20G in right forearm remains patent without erythema, edema, or tenderness.
- Infusing D5 0.45% NS at 100 mL/hr continuous.
- Administered ondansetron 4 mg IV push PRN at 1115 for mild nausea with complete resolution within 30 minutes.
- Re-evaluate white blood cell count when morning labs return.
- Continue clear liquid diet; advance to low fiber diet tomorrow per attending orders.
- Ambulated with assist x2 in hallway, covering 150 ft each lap without distress.
- Handed off care to incoming RN for night shift.

errors.quote: Administered IV ciprofloxacin 400 mg at 1000 per pharmacy schedule.
errors.explanation: The patient profile explicitly lists a severe allergy to ciprofloxacin with hives and anaphylactoid reaction, so administering this medication directly contradicts the allergy record and standard safety practices.
errors.fix: Administered IV ceftriaxone 1 g at 1000 per pharmacy schedule.

errors.quote: Handed off care to incoming RN for night shift.
errors.explanation: Standard nursing documentation for shift handoff requires the specific name of the receiving clinician taking over care to ensure an unbroken chain of custody and accountability.
errors.fix: Handed off care to incoming RN Sarah Jenkins, BSN, for night shift.
